symfony/skeleton v7.4.99 (https://github.com/symfony/skeleton, tag v7.4.99,
commit bf1abda299403468285fd4fa0514d916991c9120), MIT license. composer.json
is the skeleton's with what symfony/flex does on create-project applied

(../locks/symfony-skeleton.lock) is generated once with the official Composer.
